style.text: Surround a vermilion and orange-gold dominant form with deep indigo and dark green surroundings. Reserve pale accents for structural highlights and narrative focal points.
Let a giant near-circular form dominate the image. Converge radial lines slightly below the center and use a pale fan-shaped path to lead toward the small character group below.
Place two small characters close together, dramatically smaller than the dominant form, with clear faces, gazes and interaction.
Use painted two-dimensional color masses, fine decorative linework and uneven paper-like grain. Let environmental strokes interrupt selected silhouette edges while keeping faces clear.
Interweave radial structure with diagonal motion strokes. Derive ornament from the current theme and reduce detail around faces and text.
Place a large white hand-lettered title at the top and smaller legible white copy at the bottom, keeping text and the main image from overlapping.

character.text: The theme is {{theme}}, the giant dominant form is {{focus}}, and the two characters are {{characters}}.

environment.text: Set the scene in {{setting}}. Use {{motion}} for diagonal motion, with stronger foreground strokes and weaker distant detail.

narrative.text: Lead attention from the warm dominant form through the radial convergence toward the two characters below. Establish an emotional resting point through proximity, shared attention and connected gestures.

mood.text: Create pressure through environmental motion and monumental scale, and convey companionship through the characters' proximity.

instructions.text: Use {{title}} as the top title and {{tagline}} as the bottom copy. Add no other readable copy or logos.
